_doc: Story 047 Part B. chapters: chapters.json id -> art region folder under assets/art/env/ (art bible 8.1). default: region when a chapter is unmapped or the id is empty. fallback_bands: flat sky / ground drawn by BackdropLayer when a region has no backdrop art; sky rows above the 20 % board band, ground below. Hex values from art bible 6.4 where it gives one (forest mist, ice_tower, lattice_heart); the others are PLACEHOLDERS named after the table's words, for art-director to confirm.
_doc_half_tints: 2026-10-31 (user: the player's and the enemy's halves must differ in colour). Multiply tints FloorLayer lays on each half's slabs and stamps (a region.json `half_tints` overrides these). Player cool blue; enemy a darker, gloomier plum (user: "sân của địch thì sẽ có màu u ám hơn đặc trưng của quái vật"): red is the telegraph's colour and orange is Burn (art bible P3), so neither half may be red or orange.
